'''Magikarpenter''' (Japanese: '''コイ・キンゲン''' ''Koi Kingen'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN026|Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown!]]''.

Magikarpenter competed in the tenth annual [[Magikarp High Jump Competition]] with his {{p|Magikarp}}. He went up against [[Goh]] and his {{TP|Goh|giant Magikarp}} in the semifinals but ultimately lost to him.
